what: Pin the section to the screen and (+=140%, scrub .6) the screen (video·photo) that was folded to 35% on all sides and looked like a small window with 8px rounded corners opens up to 13% (.16~.58, power2.inOut). At the same time the four-corner frame grows from 30% → 74%, the background moves from a dark panel to a light one (first .2), and the heading above slides 28px up and out at .22. The progress bar fills fully, the control buttons rise at .58 and drop at .78, and in the last .78~1 the top and bottom bands close (power2.in) and the frame disappears, leading into the next dark section
